name: @dcmjs-org/encapsulated
description: Encapsulated document IODs: wrap a document into a conformant naturalized DICOM dataset and recover the exact bytes from a parsed instance. PDF (SOP Class 1.2.840.10008.5.1.4.1.1.104.1) today; the other encapsulated-document types (CDA, STL, OBJ, MTL) share the same home
